# Prompt Pattern: AI Review Test Case

Use this skill to review existing test case documents.

## Template
Review test cases: <file-paths>
Scope: <functional|non-functional|both>
Requirements: <refs optional>
Risk context: <optional>

## Example
Review test cases: test-cases/TC-US-001-Customer-Login.md
Scope: functional
Requirements: requirements/US-001-customer-login.md
